name: Exp_ColorXMUV_Tm
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXMUV indicator, which is a colored moving average trend-following system. It enters long positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change to upward) and short positions when it turns bearish, with a built-in time filter to restrict trading to specific hours. The EA includes trailing stop functionality and position management for trend continuation trades.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXMUV指标进行交易，这是一个带颜色的移动平均趋势跟踪系统。当指标转为看涨颜色时做多，转为看跌颜色时做空，并内置时间过滤器限制特定时段交易。EA包含移动止损功能和趋势延续的仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXMUV指标的颜色变化来判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为指标颜色从看跌转为看涨时开多单，从看涨转为看跌时开空单，本质上是移动平均线的交叉或斜率变化信号。出场条件包括移动止损追踪、固定止损止盈以及时间过滤器到期时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式，同时设置了最大持仓限制以控制风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供了风险百分比参数来动态调整每笔交易的下单量，但缺乏基于波动率的自适应仓位调整机制。时间过滤器允许用户设定交易时段，避免在市场流动性差或波动剧烈的时段进行交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorXMUV indicator's color changes to determine trend direction, representing a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions trigger long positions when the indicator color shifts from bearish to bullish, and short positions when it shifts from bullish to bearish, essentially capturing moving average crossover or slope change signals. Exit conditions include trailing stop tracking, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and position closure when the time filter expires. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or equity-based calculation, with maximum position limits set to control risk exposure. Money management provides risk percentage parameters for dynamically adjusting trade sizes, but lacks volatility-based adaptive position sizing. The time filter allows users to define trading sessions, avoiding periods of poor liquidity or excessive volatility.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：0=固定手数,1=按风险百分比计算

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险占总资金的百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade of total capital

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，顺势交易胜率相对较高
内置时间过滤器，可规避不利交易时段
具备移动止损功能，能锁定浮动盈利
支持固定手数和风险百分比两种仓位管理模式
指标颜色变化直观，信号判断简洁明确
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic with relatively higher win rate when trading with the trend
Built-in time filter to avoid unfavorable trading sessions
Trailing stop functionality locks in floating profits
Supports both fixed lot and risk percentage position sizing modes
Indicator color changes are intuitive and signal judgment is straightforward
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易频繁止损
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分趋势和震荡行情
没有波动率自适应的仓位调整，在高波动期风险敞口可能过大
依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多因子确认
移动止损参数固定，未考虑ATR等动态止损方式
cons_en: Trend-following strategy suffers frequent stop-outs in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks market regime detection to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
No volatility-adaptive position sizing, risk exposure may be excessive during high volatility
Relies on single indicator signal without multi-factor confirmation
Fixed trailing stop parameters without dynamic ATR-based adjustment
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中减少或暂停交易
引入ATR动态止损和移动止损，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离
增加多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce or pause trading in ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and trailing stop that auto-adjusts based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 震荡行情中可能连续止损导致较大回撤
缺乏账户整体风险控制机制，如最大回撤限制
固定止损在剧烈波动时可能被跳空击穿
risk_points_en: Consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets may cause significant drawdowns
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits
Fixed stop-losses may be gap-slipped during extreme volatility
